offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and commercializes diagnostic imaging agents and radiopharmaceuticals, including PET and SPECT agents and ultrasound contrast agents. Sells to hospitals, imaging centers and radiopharmacies, with products made at its own and contract manufacturing sites.

primary_products.value: PET imaging agents for prostate cancer; ultrasound contrast agents; SPECT nuclear cardiology imaging agents; radiopharmaceutical therapeutic candidates

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, imaging centers, radiopharmacies, cardiology and oncology practices

end_markets.value: healthcare; oncology diagnostics; cardiology diagnostics; nuclear medicine

revenue_model.value: product sales: diagnostic imaging agents and radiopharmaceuticals sold to radiopharmacies and healthcare providers; licensing or royalties: license and royalty revenue from partner agreements

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: produces radiopharmaceutical and contrast agents in-house and via contract manufacturers, sold to radiopharmacies and hospitals; brand owner: develops and markets branded diagnostic agents to imaging providers

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Canada, Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: PET, SPECT and ultrasound contrast diagnostic imaging agents plus radiotherapeutic development

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force calling on hospitals, imaging centers and physicians; distributors / dealers: radiopharmacy networks and specialty distributors delivering unit doses

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drugs and radiopharmaceuticals requiring FDA approval, also NRC and state radioactive materials rules, EMA abroad
